cobblehardcoremon.configuration.title: Cobble Hardcore Mon Configuration
cobblehardcoremon.configuration.server.t: The item ID of the Totem item that prevents a Cobblemon from being lost when it faints.
cobblehardcoremon.configuration.server.g: Whether the health link feature is enabled globally for all players. If enabled, individual players cannot change their health link setting.
cobblehardcoremon.configuration.server.b: Battle tracking configuration. These settings determine which types of battles are tracked for Cobblemon fainting events.
cobblehardcoremon.configuration.server.m: Messages displayed to the player when a Cobblemon faints and is removed from their party. You can use {pokemon} as a placeholder for the Pokemon's name.
Message displayed when a Cobblemon faints and the player has a Totem item. The Totem item will be consumed and the Cobblemon will be saved.
Message displayed when a Cobblemon faints and is removed from the player's party.
cobblehardcoremon.configuration.permissi: Permissions configuration for CobbleHardcoreMon mod. These settings determine which players have access to certain commands and features.
Permissions for commands provided by the CobbleHardcoreMon mod. You can set the permission level required to execute each command.
Permission level required to execute the /hardcoremon command. This command allows players to manage their Cobblemon health link settings and view their party status.
Permission level required to execute the /hardcoremon setHealthLink command. This command allows players to toggle the health link feature for their own party.
Get Health Link Command Permission Level
Permission level required to execute the /hardcoremon getHealthLink command. This command allows players to view the health link status of their own party.
Get Health Link Other Command Permission Level
Permission level required to execute the /hardcoremon getHealthLink <player> command. This command allows players to view the health link status of another player's party.
Force Health Link Command Permission Level
Permission level required to execute the /hardcoremon forceHealthLink command. This command allows players to force the health link feature for another player's party.
